claims.sourceText: American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 'Meet The Startup Summoning UFOs: Skywatcher', published 28 May 2025, at 0:02:33 and 0:05:12
claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 28 May 2025, Michels introduces his guest at 0:02:33 with 'I'm here with James Fowler', and at 0:05:12 Fowler said he 'started out in the military', 'retired as a sergeant major, retired in 2020', spent 'about 23 years working for the government', and that after retiring he 'started several companies and some of my companies were contracted by the government to do different war game projects'.

claims.sourceText: American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 'Meet The Startup Summoning UFOs: Skywatcher', published 28 May 2025, at 0:05:12 to 0:10:17
claims.text: In the same episode, at 0:05:12 and again at 0:08:35, Fowler said the effort began with an observation during a government war game he was running in 2021, whose deliverable was tactics, with a blue team fielding air-defence and counter-drone systems against a red team, and that on the last day of the event his camera operator showed him 'the class one formation of seven, the first sighting we had'. At 0:06:04 he said he is 'the lead operations guy' and not the discoverer, naming two colleagues only as Mr. K and Mr. D because they wish to remain anonymous.
